proposition: Nafsat II traces Jazarī's enmity to Ibn Turka's candid assessment of him to the Mamluk sultan in Egypt, which Jazarī could not name in Fars; this is Ibn Turka's own version of a grievance against a rival, and MK gives no corroboration on these pages.
